criteria.scope: Small synthetic retrieval validation. Final answer evaluation and human review remain separate.

policy: same fixed query/filters for recent baseline and exact cosine; 10 candidate chunks; 5 deduplicated sources; no threshold or reranker
limitations: Synthetic data, one repetition. Cached actual vectors separate query preparation latency from lookup latency. No final-answer, human-review, HTTP latency, production or full 30-question quality claims. No-evidence questions measure retrieval behavior only; retrieved candidates are not evidence judgments.
